title: Ten:07 Introduces the Unicorn Pony Titanium Modular Cargo Bike
content:
Ten:07 Cycles is expanding the Pony family with the Unicorn Pony Titanium. The fun-sized, highly anticipated mini cargo bike has been re-engineered in sexy titanium and equipped with their signature quick-release platform.

Bearing the same footprint and style as the original steel Pony, the Titanium Pony keeps the compact wheelbase and modular versatility that made the Pony a hit. Riders get the same commuter-quick handling and load hauling, but now paired with the quick-release platform that made the original Unicorn Cargo Bike a hallway-friendly classic, plus a frame that’s noticeably lighter to carry up the stairs when the ride’s done.

Unicorn Pony Titanium Quick Hits

  • Signature Quick-Release Platform: The mechanism that made the original Unicorn Cargo Bike famous, now on the Pony. Detach the cargo platform in seconds to store the bike in a narrow hallway or strip it down for a lighter ride.
  • Titanium Frame: Lighter than steel, naturally corrosion-resistant, and built to hold up to years of daily city riding without the maintenance steel demands.
  • Nimble Handling: Incredibly agile. The compact geometry means quick handling and zero hesitation when navigating traffic or tight city corners.
  • Universal Fit: A smart, adaptable one-size-fits-all frame design that easily adjusts to comfortably accommodate any rider in the household.
  • Ultra-Compact Design: A space-saving, highly stylish frame that’s just as easy to park at your favorite cafe as it is to ride.
  • Interchangeable Cargo Base: An optional accessory allows riders to swap out the standard platform for a mount fully compatible with MIK and AVS systems. Click in a crate, a grocery basket, or a commuter bag, and change your cargo setup in seconds.
  • Sleek Internal Routing: The frame features internal routing for both dynamo lighting and a dropper post, keeping the bike’s aesthetic exceptionally clean while protecting essential cables from the elements.
  • Dynamo front light mount
  • Internal routing for dynamo through fork and left/right chainstay for front and rear lights
  • Internal dropper post routing
  • Internal front derailleur routing
  • Front wheel 20″, rear wheel 24″
  • 3-pack mounts on fork and down tube for extra cargo
  • Standard + custom rack mounts
  • Belt drive compatible
  • Double kickstand support
  • Pricing TBD, pre order opening end of 2026

Stay updated on the preorder over at Ten:07.
